notes.notes:

-Chris

notes.title: FORCED patch 1.07 live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We set patch 1.07 live this morning, and it’s a patch we’re quite excited about!
It brings a large rework to the controller input and should hopefully fix most of the controller issues out there.
While getting this patch out we’ve been devoting more and more resources to network fixes, so stay tuned for improvements in the near future!

Here's the changelog:


FORCED v1.07 changelog
28/11/2013

General

Fixed an issue with crystals of players being misaligned after people dropping out of the game.
Fixed an issue with clients not being able to see Balfus moving when placed.
Fixed an issue with people getting stuck in pause if a player left during the first cut-scene of the tutorial.
Fixed an issue with controllers not being able to navigate the settings menu properly.
Fixed an issue with the server list changing search range when pressing refresh often.
Fixed an issue with the Challenge objective not failing when you died in Singleplayer.


Controller Input

Implemented a better reader for X-input. This should make it easier for the game to recognize Xbox type controllers.
If you have trouble with the new system, try the solutions in this thread again;
http://steamcommunity.com/app/249990/discussions/0/666824800513308087/



Thanks to everyone in the community for reporting bugs and helping us track down the causes.

notes.title: FORCED patch 1.05 is live!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.05 brings a number of fixes to issues the community has helped us track down, as well as aid to determine which hosts are viable connections when searching through the server list.

Here's the changelog:

FORCED v1.05 changelog
01/11/2013

General

Introduced a Second Life to singleplayer. The first time you die in a Trial you will be resurrected and invulnerable for a short time. This should bring the singleplayer experience more in line with how multiplayer works, that is, not an instant loss. If you use the second life, you will not be able to get the Challenge crystal from the Trial.
Fixed an issue with the tutorial not progressing in the last room when playing in Swedish, Portugese, Spanish
Fixed an issue with ability descriptions not appearing when right-clicked after having rebinded the right-click.
Fixed an issue with some systems getting a black screen on startup when on a wireless connection.





Trials

Trial 17: Fixed an issue with the challenge being impossible in multiplayer.


Achievements

Fixed an issue with the Volatile Omelet achievement not awarding correctly.
Fixed an issue with the Student of Pain achievement not awarding correctly.
Fixed an issue with the Hodor achievement not showing as completed in Steam.
Fixed an issue with progress achievements not updating correctly.


Network

Implemented connection status icon for the server list. This small indicator to the far right will show how well you can connect to a game, while the indicator at the top of the screen will show your ability to host. Green is good, yellow is some problems, red is bad and grey is unknown. This is an early version, and we know of an issue where some good connections will display as grey.
If you click on the details at the top of the screen you will get info about your status, which should help you find solutions to improve your ability to host.
Fixed an issue with people not receiving a response from a drop-in server they had joined.
Fixed an issue with people not returning to the main menu after a host disconnected.


Survival

Fixed an issue with Survival times from the Amphitheatre not being uploaded.



From here on we'll keep working on the network, as we're currently getting a lot of data that'll help us improve on the solution.

notes.title: Patch 1.02 going live!
notes.notes:
This patch contains: 

A fix in corrupted files that we believe made some trials unplayable or made the game crash at load times on some systems.

The warlock would get stuck when trying to cast a spell on a Spirit Decoy. No mo’.

Search range. You can now search for games by their location relative to you (Near, Far, World wide). We still havn’t been able to fix pings for all, but this should help with the issue of finding games with good ping.

German translation had some words missing – It is fixed now! Bitte schön. 

The beginning of an invite system (for some reason you’ll have to join the game twice for it to work as it is now. Working on it)


As always, we've done some internal testing of this version, but we'll try and get right on with working on the next patch, so if you encounter any issues, please let us know. That's what we're here for ;)
- Kristian Klie - BetaDwarf's Code Monkey

notes.title: FORCED version 0.67
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, as some of you have noticed we uploaded a new build, and we're pretty excited about the stuff we've brought to you this time, even if some of it is rather small fixes and improvements.

FORCED changelog v0.67
19/10/2013


General

Aligned the versions for PC, Mac and Linux. All platforms should now be able to connect to each other
Fixed some issues with the profiles system
Fixed some issues with music and dialogue volumes and timings.
Implemented drop-out lobby, if a client leaves a 3-4 player game, the remaining players will enter a lobby together.


Hall of Trials

Chamber 4 population in Hall of Trials finalized.


Trials

Trial 9, fixed an issue with a shrine cooldown icon appearing permanently for clients.
Trial 18 - Lunch Time

Improved visual feedback of the Fly Swarm
Improved Graw’s death animation.

Trial 21, improved death animation and effect of the Blood Machine.
Trial 24, inserted and improved some visual effects to make Mordars spells clearer.
Trial 25 - The Master

Implemented remaining missing audio
Fixed an issue with players dying after the battle ended.

 Implemented new challenges for some trials

Trial 12: Don't destroy any spawnershrines
Trial 13: Don't recieve any healing
Trial 16: Call the orb only once.
Trial 18: Only let 4/6/6/8 eggs hatch.
Trial 22: Never go below 180 health.



Survival mode

The Amphitheatre now has no limit on crystals while playing.


Enemies

 Increased Taurus’ pin damage from 5 dmg/tick to 10 dmg/tick.
 Increased Warlocks pin starting damage from 1 dmg/tick to 5 dmg/tick. (Still increasing by 1 every tick.


Frost Shield

Fixed an issue with the player not being able to cast Slick Moves while holding down attack.


Storm Bow

Improved visual effect of Lightning Storm so that it doesn’t obscure the battlefield too much.


Known Issues

Some of the new challenges don’t have correct texts.

notes.title: FORCED Pre-Release Tournament On Now
notes.notes:
Indie development team BetaDwarf are hosting a free tournament in the arcade co-op game FORCED, this weekend only. You can join the FORCED pre-release tournament either through buying the full game or by downloading the free demo and compete for glorious prizes.

For the tournament video, check out http://youtu.be/foX4NJQQ3Xc

To get started, just download the demo from the FORCED store page in Steam. For more details see the FORCED tournament Steam guide here.

FORCED is currently in Steam Early Access and planning for a full release on October 24th.

notes.title: New Windows patch 0.06
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today we're bringing you a patch focused on the tournament in the Survival mode we'll be running this weekend. Here are the patch notes.

Tournament 11-13th October

BetaDwarf is running a tournament in the Survival Mode of FORCED this  weekend. There’ll be prizes from Steelseries, Alienware and Intel, livestreaming with Twitch and more!

It is now possible to stream FORCED to Twitch directly from the game

Survival mode is now available from the demo as well, which should bring more players to the community to play with.

Enemies

Reduced the speed gain of the normal swarmer group buff


Storm Bow

Fixed an issue with some shots hitting walls instead of enemies when the   two were close.


Controllers

Fixed a number of issues with wired and wireless controllers



We're expecting to update a few more things now, and Mac and Linux will follow as soon as possible.
Enjoy the weekend :)

notes.title: New Mac and Linux Patch 0.05
notes.notes:
FORCED Mac and Linux patch 0.05 Changelog 
08/10/2013 

General 
Player progression is now unified, meaning any crystals you gain carry over to other player modes (e.g. Getting 6 crystals in 1-player will mean you also have 6-crystals when playing 2-player) 
The Preparation Room has received a facelift. 
Improved game performance vastly, the game should now run much smoother on all systems.

Trials 
Tweaked a number of time trials including trial 9, 12 and 15. 
Fixed major bugs in Chamber 4. Everything should now be accessible and completable. 
Trial 25 is now available for play, have fun with the final boss. 
Introduced and tweaked Challenges for all remaining levels.

Network 
Fixed a number of issues preventing players from connecting to each other. 
Optimized network feel and load, we should see improved client-side gameplay experience as well as better hosting capacity for most people.
Survival mode 
New gameplay mode, created as a different type of game from the main menu. 
Play against hordes of enemies with a limited arsenal. The players to survive the longest will be legend!

Steam Integration 
Now saves player progression to the steam cloud - this unfortunatly means that we had to wipe all progression

Main menu & GUI 
Added leaderboards to trials, you can now compare your times to other gladiators. Show your worth! 
Main menu graphics reworked. 
Added profile system. It is now possible to create different profiles for your account. 
Improved usability to reflect drop-in functionality. A host can start the game and play while waiting for more players to join. 
Added kick player functionality for hosts. 
Fixed a number of issues with the settings menu. 
Fixed blurry UI on lower settings.
Enemies 
Added an ability and new graphics to Morgrul the Swarmer King. 
Added new graphics to the Elite Swarmers. 
Blood Carrier (formlery known as the heal swarmer) 
New graphics 
New stats to reflects it’s floaty nature.
Graw 
Upgraded graphics 
Fixed a number of graphical issues that obscured the mechanics.

Weapons 
Volcanic Hammer 
Core taunt: Added 25 healing to all allies in the radius.
Frost Shield 
New graphics for the Frost Shield, defend your allies and smite your 
enemies with the power of winter!

Audio 
Added new music tracks for bosses, different chambers and special levels. 
Added a number of new Balfus lines, especially later in the game.

Known issues 
You can’t quit the game with a controller.

notes.title: New Windows Patch 0.05
notes.notes:
FORCED Windows patch 0.05 Changelog
07/10/2013

General

    Player progression is now unified, meaning any crystals you gain carry over to other player modes (e.g. Getting 6 crystals in 1-player will mean you also have 6-crystals when playing 2-player)
 The Preparation Room has received a facelift.
 Improved game performance vastly, the game should now run much smoother on all systems.


Trials

 Tweaked a number of time trials including trial 9, 12 and 15.
 Fixed major bugs in Chamber 4. Everything should now be accessible and completable.
 Trial 25 is now available for play, have fun with the final boss.
 Introduced and tweaked Challenges for all remaining levels.


Network

 Fixed a number of issues preventing players from connecting to each other.
 Optimized network feel and load, we should see improved client-side gameplay experience as well as better hosting capacity for most people.

Survival mode

 New gameplay mode, created as a different type of game from the main menu.
Play against hordes of enemies with a limited arsenal. The players to survive the longest will be legend!


Steam Integration

Now saves player progression to the steam cloud - this unfortunatly means that we had to wipe all progression


Main menu & GUI

 Added leaderboards to trials, you can now compare your times to other gladiators. Show your worth!
 Main menu graphics reworked.
 Added profile system. It is now possible to create different profiles for your account.
 Improved usability to reflect drop-in functionality. A host can start the game and play while waiting for more players to join.
 Added kick player functionality for hosts.
 Fixed a number of issues with the settings menu.
 Fixed blurry UI on lower settings.

Enemies

 Added an ability and new graphics to Morgrul the Swarmer King.
 Added new graphics to the Elite Swarmers.
 Blood Carrier (formlery known as the heal swarmer)
   
 New graphics
   New stats to reflects it’s floaty nature.

 Graw
     
 Upgraded graphics
    Fixed a number of graphical issues that obscured the mechanics.


Weapons

 Volcanic Hammer

   Core taunt: Added 25 healing to all allies in the radius.
 Frost Shield
   
  New graphics for the Frost Shield, defend your allies and smite your      
     enemies with the power of winter!


Audio
   
  Added new music tracks for bosses, different chambers and special levels.
  Added a number of new Balfus lines, especially later in the game.


Known issues
  
  You can’t quit the game with a controller.

Before the release of Forced the 24th of October. We want to celebrate with a big tournament in our new awesome survival arena. There will be tons of prizes, youtubers and livestreaming from everywhere. All you have to do is participate for free and survive as long as you can!

Interesting, when does it start and end?
The tournament occurs in the weekend 11-13 October.
Tournament starts 9.00 am PST Friday

Singleplayer winner is found saturday 6.00pm PST 
Three player winners are found saturday 10.00pm PST 
Two player winners are found sunday 5.00pm PST 
Four player winners are found sunday 9.00pm PST
(Note specific times might be changed a bit, please check just before the weekend)

Perfect! I don't have any plans that weekend, how do I participate? 
It’s simple! just follow these interesting and awesome steps:

Find some friends or play alone, you can play 1, 2, 3 or 4 players.
Download the demo or get the early access version of FORCED  HERE 
Start the game and complete at least one trial in the campaign, then you gain access to the survival arena (it’s a good idea to complete both the trials in the demo, as they will have valuable hints to get further in the survival arena).
Then create a new game in survival arena mode and get the best possible survival time.
Once you start to get the hang of it, you should begin streaming, as you can only claim a prize if your survival time is documented with a twitch video.
Then once you’ve got your stream going, simply get the best survival time and claim the biggest honor in history :)
Note: If you use mac or linux, you must start a twitch outside FORCED, see these solutions  XSplit  or  Open Broadcaster Software - and in case you need more help,  check thischeck this.
Simple right? :) 


Got it! Show me the swag!
Great, okay notice that there are more than 30 winners! But one person can be a winner in several tournaments. Winners are selected when each of the different tournaments stop, as you saw above.

notes.title: Patch Update 0.04
notes.notes:
Hi Guys,

We've been working on all the different bugs you guys have reported for us, here's a list of the ones we believe we've dealt with.

Fixed some shader issues with older graphics cards
Fixed an issue with too few swarmers being spawned in trial 3, making it incompletable
Fixed the problem with an Acid Imp not correctly exiting Trial 5 doors
Fixed an issue with swarmers not entering arena in Trial 1
Increased performance in Chamber 2
Fixed Spirit Blades - Spirit Decoy not working in sand arenas
Fixed memory crashes by reducing memory by 66% in extreme cases
Fixed Chamber 3 Boss vine colliders never lowering
Fixed several Chamber 3 network issues
Changed graphics for Spirit Blades
Opened access to Chamber 4
Improved sound filters for Balfus Speech
More Balfus lines implemented into the game

We have also tried to fix the bug that people are being asked to login and then being told you do not have beta access. Some people who have experienced this have found that restarting the application solved the issue. 
We would love to know if anyone is still experiencing this issue. 

Great job everyone, your bug finding skills are incredible. Keep 'em coming! :)

- Alex

notes.title: First Patch update - Patch 0.02
notes.notes:
Alright guys,

You given us a lot of terrific help with your bug reports and we now have a patch that should take care of the worst issues. 

Here's a list of the fixes in this patch

General

 Swarmers should no longer get caught in the exterior of Trail 1 - Activator
 Controller support - The controller support should now be up and running as intended. If anyone still has problems with it we'd like to hear about it.


Linux

 Cannot log into steam. - We still haven't completly solved this issue. However, we've made it possible for those of you encountering this error to at least play local. The good news about this is that we have located the source of this problem and it lies with a 3rd party software from whom we are awaiting assistance to solve the issue. So regrettably you'll still have to be patient about getting to play online. 
 Linux 32bit should now open the game correctly


We have also added some more voice over and fixed a couple of smaller issues such as removing the floating Taurus in the Hall of Trials from the Linux demo xD.

We would like to thank everybody for you cooperation so far, you've been really great at helping us with bugs, delivering pictures, debug logs and crash reports. It makes it a ton easier for us. Keep up the good work folks! :)

FORCED Love <3
- Alex
